newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB in health care deal with HCF.
newsitem.headline: NAB in health care deal with HCF.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with the Hospitals Contribution Fund of Australia Ltd (HCF) to offer private health insurance to the bank's customers from next month.
HCF chief executive Terry Smith said the agreement would allow the health fund to market its products direct to the bank's large customer base.

NAB chief general manager Frank Cicutto said the deal would support the government's efforts to encourage more Australians into private health insurance and help reduce the burden on the public health system. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
